# `hk test`

- **Usage:** `hk test [FLAGS]`

Run step-defined tests

## Flags

- **`--list`** — List tests without running
- **`--name <NAME>…`** — Filter by test name (repeatable)
- **`--step <STEP>…`** — Filter by step name (repeatable)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
